items.exampleEn: Scientists predict a hot summer this year.
items.exampleZh: 科學家預測今年夏天會很熱。

items.exampleEn: He made a commitment to call his mom every week.
items.exampleZh: 他承諾每週都會打電話給媽媽。

items.exampleEn: Which color do you prefer, red or blue?
items.exampleZh: 紅色和藍色，你比較喜歡哪個顏色？

items.exampleEn: Don't trust everything you read online.
items.exampleZh: 不要盡信網路上讀到的東西。

items.exampleEn: Our surprise party for Dad is a secret.
items.exampleZh: 我們要給爸爸的驚喜派對是個秘密。

items.exampleEn: When you are in doubt, ask your teacher.
items.exampleZh: 有疑問的時候，就去問老師。

items.exampleEn: My parents oppose my plan to travel alone.
items.exampleZh: 我爸媽反對我一個人去旅行的計畫。

items.audioEn: I prefer the train because it's faster than the bus.
items.audioZh: 我比較喜歡搭火車，因為比公車快。
items.questionZh: 說話的人為什麼比較喜歡火車？

items.sentenceEn: Many people oppose the new rule at work.
items.sentenceZh: 很多人反對公司的新規定。

items.stemEn: I ____ my best friend. She never tells my secrets.
items.stemZh: 我信任我最好的朋友，她從不洩露我的秘密。

items.stemEn: There is no ____ that she is the best singer in our school.
items.stemZh: 毫無疑問，她是我們學校最會唱歌的人。

items.passageEn: My brother wants a dog, but my parents had doubts. "A dog is a big commitment," Mom said. "It will change our lifestyle." Dad didn't oppose the idea, but he preferred a cat. My brother said he would walk the dog every day. Finally, they decided to trust him. Now we have a dog, and my brother told me a secret: he likes cats too!
items.passageZh: 我哥哥想養狗，但爸媽有疑慮。媽媽說：「養狗是要長期投入的事。我們的生活方式會改變。」爸爸不反對這個想法，但他比較想養貓。哥哥說他每天都會去遛狗。最後，爸媽決定相信他。現在我們家有了一隻狗，哥哥還偷偷告訴我一個秘密：他其實也喜歡貓！

options: 狗每天晚上都叫得很吵

questions.questionZh: 哥哥告訴作者什麼秘密？

referenceEn: I prefer to walk to school.
rubricZh: prefer 後可接動名詞或 to＋原形動詞（例如 prefer walking、prefer to walk）

items.instructionZh: 用 commitment 造一個句子，說說一件需要長期投入的事。
referenceEn: Learning the piano is a big commitment.
Having a baby is a big commitment for parents.
rubricZh: commitment 指「承諾；投入」（例如 a big commitment）
主詞可用動名詞（例如 Learning the piano is）
